title: Notifications
markReadFailed: Could not mark this notification as read
markAllReadFailed: Could not mark all notifications as read

settings.title: Notification Settings
settings.myPrefsHint: These switches apply only to your account, not to customers or other staff.
settings.channelSettingsHint: These switches apply to the whole laundry. Customers receive a channel only when it is on here.
settings.whatsappNoProvider: WhatsApp is on, but no active provider is configured. Messages will not send until a provider is set.

templates.title: Approved WhatsApp templates
templates.description: Connect each notification event to its approved Twilio template. Account credentials stay in server configuration.
templates.twilioActive: Twilio is the active WhatsApp provider.
templates.otherActive: The active provider is {provider}. Saving will switch WhatsApp sending to Twilio for this organization.
templates.noProvider: No active WhatsApp provider is configured. Saving will activate Twilio.
templates.channelHint: Templates are saved separately from the WhatsApp channel switch. Enable the channel above when you are ready to send.
templates.eventHint: Use the exact notification event code, for example order.created. Each event needs its own approved template.
templates.sidHint: Copy the HX identifier from your approved template in Twilio. This field is not your Account SID.
templates.variablesHint: Copy each variable name or number exactly from Twilio. Map it to notification data or a fixed value. For order.created, available data includes order_number and estimated_ready_at.
templates.noVariables: No variables. Use this only for a template containing fixed text.
templates.sourceHint: For notification data, enter its name without a dollar sign, for example order_number. For fixed text, enter the text to send.
templates.liveHint: Saving prepares live customer sending. Confirm the template is approved, server credentials and sender are ready, and customer WhatsApp consent is recorded. Existing sandbox recipient overrides must be cleared.
templates.removeDescription: WhatsApp notifications for {event} will fail until another approved template is configured.
templates.discardDescription: Your changes have not been saved. Continue to another template?
templates.invalidEvent: Enter a valid event code, for example order.created.
templates.invalidSid: Enter HX followed by 32 hexadecimal characters.
templates.invalidSlot: Enter a variable name or a positive number exactly as shown in Twilio.
templates.invalidSource: Enter a data name or nonempty fixed text. Fixed text cannot start with a dollar sign.
templates.duplicateSlot: Each template variable must appear only once.
templates.loadFailed: Could not load WhatsApp provider configuration. Retry or ask an administrator to check it.
templates.saveFailed: Could not save the WhatsApp template. Your changes are still available to retry.
templates.saved: WhatsApp template saved and Twilio activated.
